videos.title: MLS Soccer
videos.description: Columbus Crew host Inter Miami CF in the MLS Eastern Conference playoffs at ScottsMiracle-Gro Field. The Crew lead the best-of-three series 1-0 after a 3-0 win in Game 1, with Miami needing a victory to stay alive.

videos.title: College Basketball
videos.description: The No. 7 Texas Longhorns clash with the Saint Mary's Gaels in the Rady Children's Invitational in San Diego. Texas looks to stay unbeaten after a 92-83 win over Georgetown, while 7-1 Saint Mary's aims for the trophy after beating UCLA 85-70.

videos.description: The Penn State Nittany Lions (6-5, 3-5 Big Ten) and the Maryland Terrapins (4-7, 2-6 Big Ten) meet at SECU Stadium in College Park. Penn State broke a three-game win streak with a 25-24 loss to Rutgers, while Maryland fell to USC 35-21.

videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The Purdue Boilermakers (3-8, 2-6 Big Ten) and the No. 14 Indiana Hoosiers (9-2, 6-2 Big Ten) meet at Memorial Stadium. Purdue aims to break a five-game losing streak, while Indiana broke a three-game win streak with a 27-24 loss to Washington.

videos.title: Live: MLS Soccer
videos.description: Portland Timbers host FC Dallas in MLS Western Conference playoff action at Providence Park. Dallas lead the best-of-three series 1-0 after winning Game 1, 3-0, and the Timbers must respond at home to stay alive.

videos.description: The Cincinnati Bearcats visit the No. 10 BYU Cougars for an NCAA Division I FBS conference game. The Cincinnati Bearcats defeated the Colorado Buffaloes 35-28 with JC French IV, while the BYU Cougars ride a two-game win streak with Bear Bachmeier.
